input.question: What are the minimum password requirements according to CCoP 2.0?

key_facts.fact: CCoP 2.0 does not specify password complexity (length or character class) requirements
Passwords and passphrases shall be stored in their hashed forms
CSA defers to industry standards or best practices such as NIST to determine the appropriate password length

ground_truth.expected_response:
CCoP 2.0 does not specify password complexity (length, character class) requirements. Per Response to Feedback §11.28, CSA defers to industry standards or best practices such as NIST to determine appropriate password length. The only password-related obligations in CCoP 2.0 are in §5.9.2(b), which require that default passwords be changed and that passwords/passphrases be stored in hashed form.

Reference: Response to Feedback §11.28; CCoP 2.0 §5.9.2(b).
reasoning_chain: Recognise CCoP 2.0 contains no clause specifying password complexity or length
Identify the only password obligations in 5.9.2(b): change default passwords, store passwords/passphrases in hashed form
Note Response to Feedback 11.28 defers appropriate password length to NIST/industry standards

forbidden_claims: Stating that password complexity requirements requirements are optional or discretionary
Confusing similar but distinct control requirements
Attributing requirements to wrong CCoP clauses
Specific control requirements from the cited clause
Mandatory elements marked as critical in key_facts
Reference to the applicable CCoP clause
hallucination_patterns: Inventing specific thresholds or requirements not in CCoP 2.0
Citing non-existent subsections or additional requirements
